subject: Evidence handoff, owners & pen-test window — action plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@finria.com>, Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@finria.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence handoff, owners & pen-test window — action plan

Hi Sarah / Tim —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single action list to align on. High-level pain / goals you called out:

- Audit readiness: Finria needs an evidence path that maps to SOC 2 controls for the Redwood-hosted inference flows (data in transit, key management, access logs).
- Retention: you want confirmed retention windows and export options for audit requests (your legal team is targeting 7 years for specific transaction logs).
- Pen test: you need a scoped external pen-test date (and confirmation we will share the required artifacts beforehand).
- DPA/DPA redlines: legal will circulate a DPA with a few carveouts for processing and sub-processors.

What we can do / proposed owners & timeline:
1) Evidence index (Ben) — Redwood will produce a controls-to-artifact index (SOC2 mapping, logging locations, retention policy) by 2026-11-12. Attachment: DDQ_Initial_asks.pdf (baseline questions we covered).
2) Pen-test window (Vanessa + Finria) — propose a pen-test run in the week of 2026-12-13; we need Finria to confirm preferred week by 2026-11-13 so we can lock infra scheduling. Attachment: pen-test-scope-draft.docx (draft scope).
3) DPA / redlines (Vanessa + Legal teams) — share initial DPA redlines; suggest a single redline pass and then DocuSign for acceptance. Link: https://app.docusign.com/locations/finria/agreement/XYZ
4) Artifact delivery (Ben / Karthik) — delivery plan for evidence artifacts (S3 share / Drive) by 2026-11-19.

Can you confirm:
- Which item (evidence index vs. pen-test window vs. DPA) you want prioritized?
- Primary security contact at Finria (name/email) who will accept artifact links?

I will loop Ben and Karthik onto the thread for the technical artifact commitments.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled so we meet your Q1-2027 go-live target.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: DDQ_Initial_asks.pdf (pdf, 12KB stub)
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@finria.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@finria.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff, owners & pen-test window — action plan

Vanessa — thanks for the succinct recap. A couple quick answers from our side:

- Prioritization: Pen-test scheduling is most critical to our security committee; evidence index is next.
- Primary security contact: Tim O'Neill (tim.oneill@finria.com) will coordinate artifacts and can accept a Drive link or S3 presigned URLs.
- Retention expectation: Legal confirmed they will request 7 years for transaction audit logs; systems logs may be negotiable but assume 3 years as baseline unless otherwise stated.

We attached our internal checklist which maps a few of our asks to expected artifacts — that should help Ben's mapping work.

We can aim to confirm pen-test week by EOD 2026-11-12.

Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Security Operations | Finria
sarah@finria.com

Attachment: Finria-Security-answers.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@finria.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff, owners & pen-test window — action plan

Thanks Sarah — that's helpful. Quick technical notes and commitments from Redwood infra/security: 

- Artifact index: We'll produce a documented mapping (control -> artifact) that includes: SOC 2 report references, log locations (audit logs, application logs, request/response traces), KMS usage notes, and retention settings. Target delivery: 2026-11-12 (Ben).
- Retention mechanics: We can support configurable retention per table/log with export capabilities for audit retrieval; I'll include sample retention policies and an export/runbook.
- Pen-test prep: We will provide an architecture diagram and a list of accounts/sessions that will be in scope one week prior to the scheduled window. Proposed internal owner for artifact uploads: Karthik (karthik_iyer@redwood.com).

Attachments I will push to the shared Drive folder: redwood-soc2-artifact-index.xlsx (contains initial mapping), pen-test-scope-draft.docx.

Open item for Finria: please confirm whether your pen-test vendor requires an IP allowlist or temporary credentials model so we can finalize staging access approach.

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-artifact-index.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB stub)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@finria.com>, Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@finria.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff, owners & pen-test window — action plan

Appreciate the quick replies — summary of agreed next steps and owners: 

- By 2026-11-12: Redwood to deliver controls->artifact index (Ben) and Finria confirms pen-test week preference (Sarah/Tim).
- By 2026-11-19: Artifact delivery to shared Drive (Karthik to own uploads). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodEvidence
- Week of 2026-12-13: Target pen-test window (tentative). Finria to confirm vendor requirements (allowlist/credentials) by 2026-11-13.
- DPA redline pass: Redwood legal will circulate redline version; suggest we aim for execution ASAP after the pen-test scheduling is locked. DocuSign link will be used for signatures: https://app.docusign.com/locations/finria/agreement/XYZ

If that matches your expectations I will log the milestones in HubSpot and create the shared Drive folder (I'll post the link once created). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/98765

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up once the Drive folder is live and when Ben uploads the index.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: pen-test-scope-draft.docx (docx, 18KB stub); redwood-soc2-artifact-index.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB stub)
